job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Missouri LAGERS RFP for private market consulting, not the LAFPP financial statement audit RFP. Its one-year initial term with a possible additional two-year agreement does not support the requested three-year term plus two optional one-year renewals.
quotes: Missouri Local Government Employees Retirement System (LAGERS)
soliciting qualified firms to provide private market consulting services

LAGERS plans to enter into an agreement with the selected Private Market Consultant for an initial period of 1-year after which LAGERS will retain the right (but not the obligation) to enter into an agreement with the Private Market Consultant for period of an additional 2 years with services and fees to be agreed upon by both parties.
